name: How long does a typical water-damaged window replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical water-damaged window replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a water-damaged window replacement project depends on the severity of the damage and the number of windows. A single window replacement with minor water damage might take one to two days, including proper framing and sealing. However, if there's extensive structural damage or multiple windows needing replacement, the project could extend to several days or even a week, allowing for proper drying and remediation of affected areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single window replacement with minor water damage may take 1-2 days. Extensive damage or multiple windows could take several days to a week.
